label: Mark Completeness
description: Tags the parts of the submission still lacking something its author has to supply as incomplete, and clears the tag from the rest. It acts on the submission an earlier step created, or else on the item this request is about.

subject.label: Subject
subject.description: Which resource the handler works on: "created" for what the execution created, if anything, or else the event's target (the default); "target" for the event's target even after a creation.
